items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: That was the Henry Martin that was a drummer... Whenever he would break one of his guitar strings my dad would bring it home to me.

ctx.x: So he was one of the family of the Martins?

One was a drummer and the other one was the... That was the Henry Martin that was a drummer. That's right. Well, the one that they called Coochie Martin. Whenever he would break one of his guitar strings my dad would bring it home to me.
